unit.why: A short anecdote: the Besht visits the town of R. Yosef the melamed, whose house stands next to a church; soon the church burns down and is not rebuilt.
unit.boundary_note: 'הנ"ל' refers back to R. Yosef melamed mentioned in an earlier division; the Besht's remark to him seems elided in the text

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מר' מאיר מ אופאליע שר׳ יוסף
stories.summary_en: The Besht comes to the town of the poor melamed R. Yosef, whose house adjoins a church. Yosef says he is too poor to move. Soon after, the church burns and the town's lord forbids rebuilding it on that spot.

tags.why: The story turns on the Besht's visit to the town

quotes: ולא איחר הדבר ונשרף בית ע"א
tags.why: The church burns soon after the Besht's visit, implicitly through his intervention

quotes: ולא הניח שר העיר לבנות שוב
